name: Payment Processing
definition: Specifies how a payment must be processed, for instance through which specific clearing channel.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Indicator of the urgency or order of importance that the instructing party would like the instructed party to apply to the processing of the instruction.

ClearingChannel.name: Clearing Channel
ClearingChannel.definition: Specifies the clearing channel to be used to process the payment instruction.

LocalInstrument.name: Local Instrument
LocalInstrument.definition: User community specific instrument.|Usage : When available, codes provided by local authorities should be used.

CategoryPurpose.name: Category Purpose
CategoryPurpose.definition: Specifies the high level purpose of the instruction based on a set of pre-defined categories.

SequenceType.name: Sequence Type
SequenceType.definition: Identifies the payment sequence where applicable.

AdviceType.name: Advice Type
AdviceType.definition: Specifies the type of advice to report back for the transaction.

ServiceLevel.name: Service Level
ServiceLevel.definition: Agreement under which or rules under which the transaction should be processed.

PaymentExecution.name: Payment Execution
PaymentExecution.definition: Payment execution process for which processing parameters are specified.

RelatedMandate.name: Related Mandate
RelatedMandate.definition: Mandate for which payment processing parametres are specified.

BankTransaction.name: Bank Transaction
BankTransaction.definition: Code of the underlying bank transaction.

ContactPoint.name: Contact Point
ContactPoint.definition: Specifies the notification method to be used to inform the beneficiary.
